# Agent Memory Bridge

Local-first stdio MCP server for governed project memory.

Map:

- `README.md` / `README.zh-CN.md` — product story and shortest first win
- `INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md` — canonical install and first-use procedure
- `llms-install.md` — compatibility pointer to the canonical guide
- `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md` — client-specific MCP registration
- `docs/SEMANTIC-MEMORY-POLICY.md` — when a host should consult project memory
- `docs/CONTEXT-ASSEMBLY.md` — what context is assembled after recall
- `docs/PRODUCTION-STATUS.md` — current checked-in product facts
- `docs/AUTHORITY-CONTRACT.md` — durable versus derived authority
- `SECURITY.md` — local-first security and trust boundary
- `CHANGELOG.md` and GitHub Releases — historical release narrative

The public MCP surface is exactly 17 tools, durable schema is v12, and there is
no MCP tool #18 or automatic learning. Installing the package and registering a
client are separate operations; clients sharing a project must use the same
persistent `AGENT_MEMORY_BRIDGE_HOME`.
